pairs.question: Quomodo potest primus dici, post tantos, qui supra dicti sunt?
pairs.answer: Verum intelligemus primum pro principe, vel quia is ad perfectum illis temporibus circa peritiam medicae artis praecipuus fuisse traditur.
pairs.derivation: Authorial self-posed question about why Virgil writes 'primusque Machaon' after naming many others (Thessandrum, Sthenelum, Ulixem, etc.). Dropped the framing 'De quo quaeri potest:' (meta-narration of the asking) before the interrogative; capitalized 'Quomodo'. Answer is the author's own resolution beginning at 'Verum intelligemus' and running to the first full stop; the section then ends and 2,1 begins 'Sed ut ad propositum revertamur'.
